title: Platform & developer infra
claim: Shared agent primitives your product teams compose.

page.tagline: Ship primitives other teams build on — each team installs only what it uses.

scenarios.name: Primitives, not a platform
scenarios.text: Teams import only the subpaths they need and add capability packages one at a time; the composition root is optional and a bare new Agent() stays first-class.
packages: capability packages added one at a time

scenarios.name: Into the observability you already run
scenarios.text: Oribos traces its own minimal spans; @oribos/otlp exports them with GenAI semantic conventions to your collector — one tracer handed down by the app.

scenarios.name: Publish agents as shared infrastructure
scenarios.text: Serve an MCP endpoint other teams and systems call — and compose one team's agent as a tool on another's.
